description: Stage 3 retrieval evaluation set. Gold chunks are resolved at evaluation time by matching `answer_contains` against chunk text, so judgments survive re-chunking rather than pinning fragile chunk ids.

query_classes.identifier: exact identifier lookup; favours lexical matching
query_classes.table: answer lives inside a table row
query_classes.list: answer lives inside a list item
query_classes.semantic: paraphrased; shares few or no content words with the target chunk
